formlogicPlugin.name: Sign-in codes by text (Twilio Verify)
formlogicPlugin.description: Sends the sign-in codes of apps that ask for Twilio Verify ("twilio-verify", as Coffee.Dating does) by text message, through each app owner's own Twilio account, and checks the codes people type. Each owner enters their Twilio details in their app's Settings. This site makes the requests to Twilio and fills in the owner's auth token itself: the plugin's code never sees it.

signInCodes.label: By text message, through Twilio Verify

appSettings.label: Account SID
appSettings.message: Enter the Twilio account SID: AC followed by 32 letters and digits, from the Twilio console.

appSettings.label: Verify service SID
appSettings.message: Enter the Verify service SID: VA followed by 32 letters and digits, from Twilio Verify → Services.

appSettings.label: Auth token
appSettings.help: From the Twilio console. Kept on this site, and never shown again.
appSettings.message: That auth token is not one Twilio gives.
